summary: Subtlety with Hemorrhage, Ghostly Strike, Premeditation and Preparation, plus Seal Fate from Assassination, on daggers.
rotation: Slice and Dice at 1+ combo points when down; refresh at 5 when about to drop
Cold Blood right before a 5-point Eviscerate; Thistle Tea at 10 energy or less
3-point Rupture when not ticking, with Hemorrhage right before it
Premeditation at 3 combo points or fewer (no Stealth needed)
Vanish into Ambush at 3 combo points or fewer, pooling energy; Preparation resets Vanish and Premeditation
consumes: Deadly Poison (main hand) and Instant Poison (off hand), each beside a Dense Sharpening Stone
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets: 31 Agility and 15 crit rating, and an on-use 335 attack power for 20 s every 2 min (at the pull, then on cooldown).
The fight never opens from Stealth. Stealth only comes from Vanish.
Ghostly Strike adds nothing over Hemorrhage (removing it gains 0.5), but the build requires it.
Open for beta testing: Premeditation out of Stealth and Preparation's reset list.
Elusiveness is worth 0 at 180 s and -2.9 at 300 s.
Murder (+4% damage vs Humanoids and Giants) does nothing on the generic boss. Its 2 points go to Lethality (Vile Poisons for Seal Fate Daggers). The vs Humanoid build keeps Murder 2/2.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Backstab VIII, Eviscerate VIII, Deadly Poison IV). They would add 13 to 18.
Grimstitch 4-piece and 5-piece bonuses aren't active on the synthetic gear (about +8 and +6 for Combat Daggers).
Flask of Supreme Power and Greater Arcane Elixir left out for consistency (+8 through Dragonbreath Chili).
Best Alliance race is High Order. Since client 70425 the races are within about 3 DPS of each other.
notes: Only Subtlety build, so treated as the Subtlety default.
